remarks: An impeccably updated & spacious, sun filled 2BR, 2 full BTH with easy one level living (1300+ square feet) is found at the very desirable Regency Towers. This mid city condo offers several comforts: concierge service, closed circuit security, both garage & visitor parking, along with large sun-filled rooms & a newly refurbished screened balcony. A +Big Plus+ is that Heat, Hot Water, and Gas is Included in rent! A remodeled eat in kitchen w/ss appliances and breakfast nook along w/ new luxury vinyl flooring throughout add that crisp clean look! Excellent closet/storage space. Only 9 units on this floor. Each large BR has its own BTH on opposite sides of the condo. Great for sharing or as an office/guest room!  Enjoy and relax living here while being within minutes to everything Stamford! Exterior pics do not reflect new outer balcony screen being installed in Nov.
